messages:
jordan: Quick Q — heading to Berlin next week. Company card declined for the hotel; I need to book on my personal card. Will that be reimbursed in full? Also a group dinner where some people paid on personal cards — can I submit one combined expense and split? And what do we use for currency conversion?
people-ops: Yes — personal hotel charges are reimbursable if preapproved OR if the corporate card failed. Please do one of the following before you book: 1) submit a travel preapproval, or 2) if card failed unexpectedly, file the card incident with finance within 48h after booking. Required attachments for reimbursement: itemized hotel folio, a PDF or photo of the merchant receipt, and the bank/card statement line showing the charge.
people-ops: If you're submitting for multiple people for a group meal you can either: a) Have each person submit their own share, or b) Submit one expense and include an attendee breakdown table + individual payment method notes. Finance prefers separate submissions where possible to avoid manual splits.
people-ops: Currency conversion — use the exchange rate shown on your card statement. If the statement doesn't show the rate, use a published rate (e.g., xe.com) for the transaction date and include the source in the expense notes.
people-ops: Example of what to attach in Expensify / Expense portal:
```
- itemized hotel folio (pdf)
- screenshot of bank card statement showing the charge and FX amount
- travel preapproval ID or ticket/meeting invite
- for group meals: attendee list + split table (name -> amount)
```
mike_h: Per diem question — do we default to per diem overseas or do we submit receipts?
people-ops: Per diem is opt-in. Domestic overnight trips >6 hours can use per diem; for international we have country tiers. If you opt into per diem you cannot also claim meal receipts for the same calendar day. If you prefer to claim actuals, submit itemized meal receipts instead.
mike_h: Where are the tiers documented?
people-ops: Tiers are on the travel policy page (link pasted in the preapproval form). If you want, attach the itinerary and we can tell you the applicable per diem.
elaine: Lost a taxi receipt (uber) — charge is $32. What do I do?
people-ops: For lost receipts under $25 we accept a bank transaction screenshot + note. For amounts $25–$75, include manager sign-off in the expense comments. For >$75 we need a written explanation + manager approval and finance will review. Repeated missing receipts may block future reimbursements.
travel-bot: :wave: Reminder: submit travel preapproval 72h before departure to avoid delays. Policy link: https://redwood.example/travel-policy
people-ops: If you want, @jordan, reply here with the booking attempt screenshot and I can fast-track the preapproval so finance will process the reimbursement asap. :thumbsup:
